description: List investment account activity (buys, sells, dividends and other cash events, fees, transfers), newest first, with ticker, quantity, price, and amount. Dividends have type "cash" and subtype "dividend". Default window is the last 90 days. Paginated with limit/offset (default 50, max 100). The response includes a `warnings` array of notices about banks that could not contribute (for example, a bank that needs reconnecting), each with a message and, when relevant, a reconnect_url.

account_id.description: Limit results to one investment account. Use an account id returned by list_accounts.

end_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1 to 100). Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging. Defaults to 0. Use with has_more.

start_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 90 days ago.

subtype.description: Only this subtype, for example dividend, interest, contribution, or management fee.

type.description: Only this transaction type: buy, sell, cash (dividends, interest, deposits), transfer, fee, or cancel.

name: list_investment_transactions
title: List Investment Transactions
